## Quality objectives

_Describe what "quality" means for this project across the three dimensions below. Each objective must be verifiable — it must be possible to determine, without ambiguity, whether the objective has been met._

**User-visible output quality:** _[e.g., All features shipped to users pass UAT with no critical defects open at release. User-reported defect rate stays below 2 per 1,000 sessions in the first month.]_

**Internal process quality:** _[e.g., Every pull request is reviewed by a peer before merge. No code module is merged without a linked test case.]_

**Documentation quality:** _[e.g., Every artifact produced by the project passes its acceptance checklist before being considered complete. No placeholder text remains in any delivered document.]_

## Quality assurance activities

_Assurance activities prevent defects before they occur._

| Activity | Frequency | Responsible role | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| _[Code review]_ | _[Every PR]_ | _[All developers]_ | _[Peer review of all code changes before merge]_ |
| _[Design walkthrough]_ | _[Each phase gate]_ | _[PM + tech lead]_ | _[Review of design artifacts before implementation begins]_ |
| _[Retrospective]_ | _[Each sprint]_ | _[Scrum master]_ | _[Team reflects on process and agrees on improvements]_ |
| _[UAT dry run]_ | _[Pre-release]_ | _[QA lead + users]_ | _[Users validate features against acceptance criteria before release]_ |

---

## Quality control activities

_Control activities detect and correct defects after they occur._

| Activity | Trigger | Responsible role | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| _[Regression test run]_ | _[Before each release]_ | _[QA lead]_ | _[Full regression suite executed; release blocked on critical failures]_ |
| _[Release audit]_ | _[Pre-release gate]_ | _[PM]_ | _[Verify all open defects are triaged; confirm no critical or high-severity defects ship]_ |
| _[Post-release monitoring]_ | _[First 72 hours post-release]_ | _[Dev lead + QA]_ | _[Monitor error rates and user-reported issues; hotfix if critical threshold is breached]_ |
